title: Marswalk credits and NASA sources
description: Every dataset, image, paper, document, 3D model, texture and library the app uses, with the credit line each source asks for. Generated by npm run credits (scripts/build-credits.mjs) from the provenance blocks in public/data/*.json and the hand-written list in scripts/credits-sources.mjs. Do not edit by hand.

statement.real: terrain shape and photo (HiRISE DTM 1 m + orthomosaic 25 cm), background (CTX DEM 20 m + mosaic 6 m), position of Cheyava Falls, slope values, sun shadows.
statement.artistic: the Mars colour (HiRISE and CTX are grayscale), sky and haze presets, night lamp, the start screen video and the hazard illustrations (AI-generated with Higgsfield, not mission images).
statement.modelled: rock positions (statistical model, not individual real rocks), rock shapes and close-up textures (Earth scans), the Cheyava Falls rock (hand-made after NASA PIA26401), the layered outcrop at Bright Angel (hand-made in the style of the Mastcam-Z images of sol 1217, not a copy of a specific rock), the rock-abundance layer (tagged DERIVED: HiRISE brightness through the Golombek et al. 2003 model, an estimate of rock cover, not a rock count).
notes: Real spot for the "dangerous slope" scene: about 200 m west of Cheyava Falls (x -201, z -52), 34 deg average.
There is no mesa overhang in this area; elevation data cannot contain overhangs.
statement.data_tags: Every number on screen carries a tag: DATA (measured by a mission or stated in a NASA document), DERIVED (calculated by us from DATA) or SIM (our assumption or a game choice). Published observations are historical, not current conditions. RAD measured radiation in Gale crater, not in Jezero.
